# Case studies

You have now learned nearly everything there is to know about technical aspects
of _slendr_ modeling and seen many different examples of various techniques to
to apply simulations in your own work. All that remains now is for you to do is
to gain your own experience through practice.

Here is a selection of small projects prepresenting case studies various
contexts of population genetics which should be immediately applicable in your
research.

As you will see, these range from relatively straightforward and direct
application of concepts you've already had the opportunity to see during the
practical exercises, through more detailed exploration of statistical concepts
inspired by the modeling work I needed to do in my own research, as well as some
more ambitious ideas which don't have clearly outlined solutions but I think
would be of direct benefit to anyone doing research in population and
evolutionary genomics.

- study-afs.qmd
- study-f3f4.qmd
- study-neanderthal.qmd
- study-dating.qmd
- study-admixtools.qmd
- study-lai.qmd
